question: Rangbhumi, Godan, Gaban and Vardaan are the novels written by:
solution:
The correct answer is** Munshi Prem Chand.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__​​​​​​**

__
 
• **Munshi Prem Chand** is recognised as one of the greatest Hindi authors of the first half of the **twentieth century. **He is one of the most well-known authors from the Indian subcontinent,
 
• **Godaan, Karmabhoomi, Gaban, Mansarovar, and Idgah **are some of his creations. In a book titled Soz-e-Watan, he initially published his collection of five short stories in 1907.
 
• Premchand's writings are distinguished by his engaging storytelling and use of** straightforward language. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__​​**

 
• **Ramdhari Singh Dinkar **was an Indian poet, writer, freedom fighter, patriot, and academic who wrote in Hindi and Maithili. He has been praised as a** Rashtrakavi** because his poems radiated Veer Rasa.
 
• One of the most influential Hindi poets of the modern era was** Maithili Sharan Gupt.** His works of poetry include **Jaydrath Vadh and Rang me Bhang.**
 
• Indian poet **Sumitra Nandan Pant** was born. His best-known works include** Pallav and Chidambarab.**
